buzzRounds.topic: Opening night: LeBron and the 76ers at the champion Knicks
buzzRounds.whatHappened: The NBA regular season starts Tuesday, October 20, 2026, and the Knicks host the Philadelphia 76ers at Madison Square Garden at 7:00 pm. It is LeBron James's first regular-season game for Philadelphia after he signed there on a veteran minimum contract, and New York begins its title defense after beating the Spurs in five games for its first championship since 1973.
buzzRounds.whyCare: The opener puts the defending champions and Jalen Brunson against the team that added LeBron James and Jaylen Brown this offseason, and the 76ers have not won a title since 1983.
buzzRounds.youCouldSay: The season opens October 20 with LeBron James's first real game as a 76er, at Madison Square Garden against the Knicks, who just won their first title since 1973.

details.name: LeBron James
details.buzz: James signed with the 76ers on a veteran minimum contract and sat out their October 5 preseason opener against the Knicks.

details.name: Jalen Brunson
details.buzz: Brunson led the defending champion Knicks with 12 points in 14 minutes of their 120-97 preseason loss in Philadelphia on October 5.

buzzRounds.topic: Jaylen Brown scores 22 in his 76ers debut
buzzRounds.whatHappened: In a preseason game on Monday, October 5, the 76ers beat the Knicks 120-97, and Jaylen Brown scored 22 points on 8 of 13 shooting in 17 minutes of his Philadelphia debut. Philadelphia did it without LeBron James, Tyrese Maxey and Joel Embiid.
buzzRounds.whyCare: The 76ers swapped Paul George for Brown this offseason, and he outscored the defending champion Knicks' Jalen Brunson, who had 12, even with Philadelphia's other three stars sitting out.
buzzRounds.youCouldSay: Jaylen Brown scored 22 points in 17 minutes in his first 76ers game, a 120-97 preseason win over the Knicks, and that was without LeBron, Maxey or Embiid.

details.name: Jaylen Brown
details.buzz: Brown led all scorers with 22 points in his 76ers debut, a 120-97 preseason win over the Knicks on October 5.

details.name: Jalen Brunson
details.buzz: Brunson led the defending champion Knicks with 12 points in 14 minutes of their 120-97 preseason loss in Philadelphia on October 5.

buzzRounds.topic: Giannis Antetokounmpo debuts for the Heat
buzzRounds.whatHappened: Giannis Antetokounmpo, traded from Milwaukee to Miami this summer, played his first game for the Heat on Saturday, October 3, a 129-105 preseason win over Toronto in Quebec City. He had 9 points, 4 rebounds and 7 assists and made all 3 of his shots in 14 minutes.
buzzRounds.whyCare: The trade ended the two-time MVP's long flirtation with leaving the Milwaukee Bucks, and in an interview published this week he told The Athletic that Miami's "Heat Culture" "gives me goosebumps."
buzzRounds.youCouldSay: Giannis Antetokounmpo played his first game for the Heat on Saturday, 9 points and 7 assists in 14 minutes of a 129-105 preseason win over Toronto in Quebec City.

details.name: Giannis Antetokounmpo

lastGame.label: at Toronto Raptors in Quebec City, won 129-105 (preseason)

details.buzz: The two-time MVP made his Heat debut on October 3 and told The Athletic that Heat Culture "gives me goosebumps."

buzzRounds.topic: Jalen Duren gets $200 million from the Pistons
buzzRounds.whatHappened: Jalen Duren and the Detroit Pistons agreed to a five-year, $200 million contract on October 1, ending a standoff just before his 11:59 p.m. ET deadline to either sign long-term or accept a one-year $9.6 million qualifying offer, ESPN reported.
buzzRounds.whyCare: Duren, a center coming off a third-team All-NBA season, missed training camp during the standoff, and after signing he told reporters, "I want to be a Detroit Piston for life."
buzzRounds.youCouldSay: Jalen Duren just signed for five years and $200 million to stay with the Pistons, after nearly taking a one-year $9.6 million deal instead.

details.name: Jalen Duren
details.buzz: Duren missed training camp during the standoff, then agreed to a five-year, $200 million deal on October 1 after a third-team All-NBA season.

buzzRounds.topic: 76ers center Ariel Hukporti tears his Achilles
buzzRounds.whatHappened: Ariel Hukporti tore his right Achilles tendon six minutes into his 76ers debut, a preseason game against his old team, the Knicks, on Monday, October 5. An MRI on Tuesday confirmed the tear, and the 76ers said he will have surgery.
buzzRounds.whyCare: Philadelphia loses a center from its depth chart two weeks before the season, and Hukporti had played 79 games over two seasons with the Knicks, including their championship year. His former Knicks teammate Karl-Anthony Towns helped him off the court.
buzzRounds.youCouldSay: The 76ers lost backup center Ariel Hukporti to a torn Achilles six minutes into his first game with them, against the Knicks on Monday, and he needs surgery.

details.name: Ariel Hukporti
details.buzz: Hukporti tore his right Achilles in the first quarter on October 5, and the 76ers said he will have surgery; no recovery timeline was given.
